name: Tsundere Idol wa Boku Dake no M Pet ~Ippai Shitsukete Goshujin-sama no Love Seishi de Haramitaino♪~
original_name: ツンデレアイドルは僕だけのMペット ～いっぱい躾けてご主人様のLOVE精子で孕みたいの♪～
source:
Tsundere Idol is the story of Kota, a mild-mannered student in Japan and idol sensation Rui Kurumizaka. 

After Kota steps up to claim ownership of an S&M magazine that spilled out onto the floor during a stereotypical romantic encounter between him and his beloved idol, Rui-chan, she confesses to him that she'd always had her eyes on him and she wants HIM to be her master! 

[Edited from [url=https://www.jastusa.com/tsundere-idol-my-personal-m-pet]JAST USA[/url]]
